title.description: What the proposal would do, in one line; for a capture still processing, what was received

kind.description: The record it creates or changes; picks the icon. Tasks and time entries are low-risk and can be approved together

status.description: Where it is: AI still working, couldn't understand, waiting for review, or decided

action.description: What approving it does; absent while processing or failed

check.description: What the reviewer has to do; absent while processing

fieldsToCheck.description: How many guessed fields to check; only with check = to_check

checkDetail.description: One line on what to check, or on the processing step

decidedBy.description: Who approved or rejected it; only when decided

decidedAt.description: When it was decided (UTC); only when decided

resultDetail.description: What approving did, or why it was rejected; only when decided

edited.description: Approved after the reviewer changed values; absent means false
